clue.text: Sample of part of voting form ?

indicators.note: the part comes after the voting form, so 'of' joins the two words with the form first

parts.note: a cross is the mark a voter puts on a ballot paper
a section is a part of something

explanation.surface: A query about taking a sample from part of a ballot paper.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface sounds like an opinion poll; in fact it is a voting mark followed by a part.
explanation.definitionFit: A cross-section is a representative sample, as in a cross-section of the public.

clue.text: Private Willis's opinion of the two-party system

definitions.text: Private Willis's opinion of the two-party system

parts.words: Private Willis's opinion of the two-party system
parts.note: in Gilbert and Sullivan's Iolanthe the sentry Private Willis sings that he often thinks it funny how every child is born either a little Liberal or a little Conservative

explanation.surface: A soldier's view on politics with only two parties.
explanation.walkthrough: Private Willis is the sentry in the Gilbert and Sullivan operetta Iolanthe; his song begins 'When all night long a chap remains on sentry-go' and uses this very word.
explanation.definitionFit: The sentry's song calls it funny that everyone is born Liberal or Conservative, his verdict on two-party politics.

clue.text: Historian includes Roman Art-one of eight

indicators.note: the historian's name holds the Latin word within it

parts.note: Sir Charles Oman was a British military historian
ars is the Latin, so the Romans', word for art

explanation.surface: A historian's book covers Roman art, one of eight volumes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one of eight' reads like a volume count, but an eight is a rowing crew.
explanation.definitionFit: A rowing eight has eight rowers, each of them one member of that crew.

clue.text: Fine quality of hose in Kent

definitions.meaning: stockings are prized for being thin and transparent
a town on the Isle of Sheppey in the county of Kent

explanation.surface: Fine stockings bought in Kent.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent is a county in south-east England; the town sits at the mouth of the Medway.
explanation.definitionFit: Transparent thinness is what makes stockings fine, and the same word names a Kentish port town.

clue.text: Always five short? That's weird!

indicators.note: short of means lacking, so the numeral is taken away from the word for always

parts.note: ever means always
V is the Roman numeral for five
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Something always comes up five short, which seems strange.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' removes V from EVER to leave EER, and IE follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Something strange and unsettling is described as uncanny or spooky.

clue.text: Drink, a feature of this educational event

parts.note: tea is a drink
the chin is a feature of the face

explanation.surface: Drinks are a feature of a lecture gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feature' means a part of the face here, not a highlight of the event.
explanation.definitionFit: A teach-in is an informal series of lectures and discussions on a topic, a kind of educational event.

clue.text: Ottoman for stout fellow—£1!

parts.note: OS is short for outsize, the clothing size for stout people
man is a fellow
L is the pound sign's letter and 1 looks like I

explanation.surface: A stout fellow offered a pound for a piece of furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: An ottoman is also a padded seat, which the surface plays on; here it means a Turk of the Ottoman empire.
explanation.definitionFit: Osmanli is the Turkish name for a member of the Ottoman people, from the empire's founder Osman.

clue.text: The bandit is disabled, but will take your money

definitions.text: The bandit is disabled, but will take your money

parts.words: The bandit is disabled, but will take your money
parts.note: a one-armed bandit has a single arm, so is disabled, and it swallows gamblers' coins

explanation.surface: A robber is crippled yet still robs you.
explanation.walkthrough: A one-armed bandit is the slang name for a coin-operated gambling machine with a lever.
explanation.definitionFit: The slot machine, worked by a single lever and showing symbols of cherries and lemons, is the one-armed bandit.

clue.text: Some err dissembling a sense of contrition

indicators.note: disguising the true form, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A wrongdoer pretends while feeling sorry.
explanation.definitionFit: Remorse is deep regret for a wrong done, a feeling of contrition.

clue.text: The plan of Carmen ?

parts.note: Carmen split into car men gives the drivers' plan of routes

explanation.surface: Asking about the plot of Bizet's opera.
explanation.walkthrough: Carmen is the opera heroine, but read as car men it means motorists, whose plan is a chart of routes.
explanation.definitionFit: A motorist's chart of highways is a plan for car drivers.

clue.text: Decide in advance Red Peter's involvement with underground working

indicators.note: involvement means entanglement, so these letters are twisted together

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written
a mine is a working beneath the ground

explanation.surface: Red Peter's role in a secret underground movement was decided early.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involvement' scrambles RED PETER into PREDETER; 'underground working' is a mine, not a resistance group.
explanation.definitionFit: To determine beforehand is to settle or decide in advance.

clue.text: Immigrant has right to follow cash receipts

indicators.note: the letter for right comes after the money word

parts.note: income is the money one receives

explanation.surface: An immigrant is entitled to follow the money coming in.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who comes in from elsewhere to settle is a newcomer or immigrant.

clue.text: In French he can perhaps heighten the effect

parts.note: en is French for in

indicators.note: perhaps suggests these letters may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: Speaking French could make things more effective.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges HE CAN into HANCE.
explanation.definitionFit: To intensify or improve something is to heighten its effect.

clue.text: "Prosperous" dukedom

parts.note: read as Prospero's, it is the duchy of Shakespeare's magician in The Tempest

explanation.surface: A wealthy duchy.
explanation.walkthrough: The quotation marks show 'Prosperous' is to be split: Prospero's, whose duchy he lost before the play began.
explanation.definitionFit: In The Tempest, Prospero is the rightful Duke of the Italian city, usurped by his brother Antonio.

clue.text: Wild rose causes broken leg to worker in European capital

indicators.note: broken means damaged, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: an ant is a worker in the insect world

indicators.note: a capital letter is the first, so this picks the start of the following word

explanation.surface: A wild rose leads someone to break a leg while working in a European capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' makes EGL from LEG; 'capital' gives the capital, or first, letter of 'European', E, not a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Eglantine is the sweetbriar, a wild rose with fragrant leaves.

clue.text: Final obstruction the defence may find fatal

parts.note: last means final
a ditch is an obstruction dug across the way

explanation.surface: A last trench that defenders may die in.
explanation.walkthrough: To die in the last ditch is to fight to the end, so the last defensive line is where defenders fall.
explanation.definitionFit: A desperate final stand is where a defence fights to the death.

clue.text: Includes order to park in times of danger

indicators.note: the order and park letters go inside the word for danger

parts.note: crises are times of danger
OM is the Order of Merit
P is the abbreviation for park, as on road signs

explanation.surface: An instruction to park during emergencies is included.
explanation.definitionFit: To be made up of, or contain, is to include.

clue.text: Does he: execute papal orders?

parts.note: papal orders are bulls, and execute means kill

explanation.surface: Asking whether some official carries out the Pope's commands.
explanation.walkthrough: A papal bull is an edict; this man kills bulls in the ring.
explanation.definitionFit: The bullfighter who makes the kill puts bulls to death.

clue.text: It's a fruit substitute with theatrical undertones

definitions.meaning: a stalk eaten as a dessert fruit
the word extras mutter to fake background conversation on stage

explanation.surface: A fruit replacement with a hint of the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: Actors in a crowd scene murmur this word over and over to sound like a hubbub.
explanation.definitionFit: Stage extras mumble the word as a stand-in for real speech; it is also a pink stalk cooked as a fruit.

clue.text: Primate -owing money for curtain

parts.note: DR stands for debtor, one who owes money
an ape is a primate

explanation.surface: An ape in debt is offered a curtain.
explanation.definitionFit: A drape is a long curtain or hanging cloth.

clue.text: Duenna concealing love for soldier

indicators.note: concealing means hiding inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a fierce chaperone is called a dragon
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A chaperone hides a lover from a soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: A duenna is a Spanish chaperone; a fearsome one is a dragon.
explanation.definitionFit: A dragoon is a cavalryman, a mounted soldier.

clue.text: Produce shortened form of a card game

parts.note: bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: Shortening the rules of a card game.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge is to shorten a text, cutting it down.

clue.text: Gate-Crash-or get under it, perhaps!

indicators.note: perhaps shows the letters may be put another way

explanation.surface: Gatecrash a party, or sneak in beneath the gate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges UNDER IT.
explanation.definitionFit: To force oneself in uninvited is to gatecrash.

clue.text: She comes from eastern isle, badly made-up

indicators.note: made up badly, so these letters are recomposed

explanation.surface: A woman from an eastern island wears poor make-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly made-up' turns ISLE into LSIE.
explanation.definitionFit: Elsie is a woman's name, so a she.

clue.text: Plan to help put back weight

indicators.note: putting back means turning it round, reading from the end

parts.note: aid means help
a gram is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A scheme to help someone regain weight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put back' sounds like regaining, but turns AID into DIA.
explanation.definitionFit: A diagram is a drawn plan or chart.

clue.text: So bottoms up!

parts.note: bottoms up is a drinking toast, but read literally it describes something stood on its ends

explanation.surface: A toast: drink up!
explanation.definitionFit: With an end foremost or upward, as when an item is stood on its base.

clue.text: Unlike the ways round Lucy's dwelling

definitions.text: Unlike the ways round Lucy's dwelling

parts.words: Unlike the ways round Lucy's dwelling
parts.note: Wordsworth's Lucy poem begins: She dwelt among the ... ways, so the opposite is ways walked on

explanation.surface: Contrasting paths around a girl's home.
explanation.walkthrough: Wordsworth's Lucy poems include 'She dwelt among the untrodden ways'; drop the 'un' for the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: Paths that are well walked are beaten, the reverse of Lucy's untouched ways.

clue.text: Better opportunity, for soprano?

parts.note: a better, one who bets, takes this football pools option, and a soprano voice in a choir boy is high

explanation.surface: A singer gets a superior chance.
explanation.walkthrough: The treble chance was a British football pools bet on drawn matches; a treble is a high boy's voice, so a soprano's chance.
explanation.definitionFit: The pools bet was a gambler's chance of a big win, and a boy soprano's chance would be his.
